entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac. I'm calling about a VeloBand Cadence Sensor I bought a little over a month ago. I'd like to see what my options are for a return.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's just a preference, it works fine. I'm just not using it. I know it's been a while, and I was worried it might be too late, especially with rules about hygiene for worn devices. I'm hoping we can work something out, maybe a partial credit?
I appreciate you explaining that. Let me just pull up your order and our current return policy for that item. One moment.

Okay, I see the order here. It was delivered 37 days ago. I understand your concern about our policy, as sanitation is a priority for items worn on the body. However, the VeloBand Cadence Sensor is actually covered by our 90-day return window.
Wait, 90 days? Oh, seriously? I was sure I was going to be told no.
Nope, you're well within the timeframe, so it's not too late at all. I can process a full refund for you right now. No negotiation needed.
Wow, that's fantastic news. That was much simpler than I thought it would be. Yes, please go ahead.

Excellent. I have just initiated that return for you. I've sent a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. Simply pack the sensor in its original packaging, attach the label, and you can drop it off at the post office. Your refund will be processed once we receive it.
Perfect. Thank you so much for your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
